subject: Information about your upcoming flight
body: Dear [Name], We are writing to inform you that your upcoming flight from New York to Los Angeles has been rescheduled due to unforeseen circumstances. Your new departure time is now at 10:00 AM instead of the original 8:00 AM. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding. Please let us know if you have any questions or need further assistance. Best regards, The Airline Team
